votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of January 9, 2024, and January 16, 2024, as well as the formal meeting minutes of December 12, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved the minutes from two prior work sessions and one formal meeting to establish the official record of those proceedings.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 02 of 2024 Recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly adopted a ceremonial resolution designating February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City, recognizing the contributions and history of Black Americans.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the rezone at 357 and 375 East 500 South, 464-466 South 400 East, and 460-462 South 400 East to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council voted to keep the public hearing open and continue it to a future meeting, allowing more time for public input and information on the proposed rezone from RMU-45 to TSA-UC-C.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 3 of 2024 amending the Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City Library including the employment staffing document only for items as shown on the motion sheet.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted the Library's first budget amendment for FY2023-24, which includes a 1% cost of living increase for all Library employees and a new full-time Safety Team employee, among other items.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 04 of 2024 amending the Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document only for items as shown on the motion sheet and authorize release of the condition regarding the temporary sanctioned campground funding.
votes.description: The Council adopted a partial adoption of Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2023-24, which includes new paramedic positions, a new Legislative Division in the City Attorney's Office, and additional transportation impact fees, among other items, and released a funding condition related to a temporary sanctioned campground.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 05 of 2024 approving a $100,000 loan for Eats, LLC, from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $100,000 loan from the Economic Development Loan Fund to Eats, LLC (a vegan bakery), to assist in creating three new jobs and retaining two existing jobs.

votes.motion: Confirm intent expressed in the motion of November 7, 2023 adopting the ordinance rezoning 1435 South State Street with conditions requiring replacement of demolished dwelling units and a minimum of 40% active ground floor facade fronting State Street that is not residential or parking, extending at least 25 feet into the building.
votes.description: The Council clarified the conditions of its prior rezone approval for 1435 South State Street, specifying requirements for dwelling unit replacement and active ground-floor uses along the State Street facade in the required development agreement.

The Council approved the full Consent Agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for multiple ordinances and resolutions and approving Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 4) for FY2023-24.
